not_supported: Cough is persistent. -- The most recent cough assessment before the decision time (R49) describes the cough as 'Loose non-productive', not 'persistent'. While earlier records show intermittent coughing, the latest record does not support the claim of a persistent cough.

Broad-spectrum intravenous antibiotics are currently being given. -- The records document antibiotic treatment (R41, R43) but do not show an administration record of intravenous antibiotics within 24 hours before the decision time. The only IV administrations are Lactated Ringer's, esomeprazole, and enoxaparin, none of which are antibiotics.

An analgesic regimen is currently being given. -- The records show a PRN morphine order (R2) and a one-time morphine administration over 24 hours before the decision time (R1), but no analgesic administration within the 24 hours preceding 2100-01-02 13:57. Treatment documentation mentions analgesics (R12, R29, R43), but this does not confirm current administration.
